title: design-system.yml builds in an unprivileged job (no id-token, no npm token, scripts off) and publishes a tarball from a separate job with --ignore-scripts

criteria.given: the job that runs npm ci or npm run
criteria.then: it holds no id-token: write, no NODE_AUTH_TOKEN and no registry-url, and npm ci runs with --ignore-scripts
it does not check out the repository or run npm ci / npm run, and its npm publish passes --ignore-scripts and --provenance for a tarball path
it runs in the npm-publish environment and only when the build is not a dry run
